text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, sea! What must El do
to reach the top of the world?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Staying true to my original goal! Should I aim for the Japan Cup over the Triple Crown route's Kikuka Sho, or...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Sei-chan!
Aiming for the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, can you keep up with me~?
Taaaaah!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oho, Spe-chan and Sei-chan! Their speed and stamina have sharpened even further, and their fighting spirits are blazing hot!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Competing with my classmates really might be the shortest path to my dream!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I... won't be proceeding down
the Autumn Classic road, though.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Que? Grass, you aren't going to
the Kikuka Sho? Where are you going, then?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: First—on to the Mainichi Okan.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, the one I'm scheduled to run in?
Why?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: There were two decisive factors behind the judgment.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
First and foremost is "distance aptitude."
3000m in the Kikuka Sho is simply too long for me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And the other reason is—
because I want to race with "that person."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That person—?
(Dadadada!)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaat, who is that~?!
A sudden gatecrasher...?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
S-So fast~!! I can't catch up~!
Wait, you're... !?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Spe-chan?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I didn't notice you.
I was just so focused on running.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohhh... What is that, YES?!
That running form isâ!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: "Unfazed by the damp sand, her legs cut through it with beautiful strides, followed by a gliding acceleration! That person is—"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It's Silence Suzuka-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"A silent speedster who has left every Umamusume in the dust
with a runaway lead in a whole different dimension."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Known as one of the strongest in the Senior Class.
She's entering the Mainichi Okan too.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: See you later, Spe-chan. Bye-bye.
(Dadadada!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-saaan!
Ah, she's... already gone...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Silence... Suzuka-senpai...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Primera...
Number one... sky...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, she is probably flying higher in the sky
than anyone else, yes! Higher than me or Spe-chan!"

That night, I decided to discuss autumn plans with
El Condor Pasa.
Together with her close friend, Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
I—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'd really rather go for the Mainichi Okan
instead of the Kikuka Sho, yes I would!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Before the Japan Cup,
just so I can race with Silence Suzuka-senpai!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I felt it today. That person right now is likely
the strongest, fastest Especialista!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: To prove I'm the world's strongest, she's an opponent I must beat by a mile.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It is true that I wasn't able to run as well as I'd hoped in the Derby.
However...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The world's strongest! Once you hang up that sign, you can't
just take it down so easily, yeeeeeees!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"To prove that, I have to pit El-El's true strength against them
before the Japan Cup!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"At the Mainichi Okan, against Suzuka-senpai!
And against Grass, too."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh, me?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Si, that's right. It's still in the making, but in the
future, my greatest rival—will surely be Grass.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass is my one and only "Péngyǒu"!
I want to show her how strong I am right now, and see her strength for myself, desu.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
We're certainly only halfway there... But even
an immature flower has a vividness born of its youth.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I accept that challenge, El.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, is this okay, YES?
Going from the Mainichi Okan to the Japan Cup.
choice_data_list: It's going to be a brutal race, you know?
It's going to be a tough race, you know?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I know that. Even so...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you very much! That settles it, then!
The Condor flies... East!

A summer decision. El Condor Pasa chose
to challenge higher skies rather than stay
within her comfortable limits.

—Silence Suzuka.
A challenge against aircraft soaring far above at the speed of sound.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Alright, once I've made up my mind, it's full steam ahead!
I have to surpass Suzuka-senpai at this training camp!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what is it that El lacks compared to Suzuka-senpai?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
There must be areas other than speed where I fall short!
I want to do something about that, *yes*!

What Silence Suzuka has,
that El Condor Pasa doesn't. That is...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Break! Through! Power! Ah, I see, I see~.
Suzuka-senpai really is the type to blow right past everyone from the start!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
All right, El won't lose either!
Charge, charge, just like that!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Um, El?
What are you planning to do with that hole in the sand?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Today, El is Drill Condor Pasa!
Just like Suzuka-senpai, with a bang-bang-boom... wait.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¿Qué? I can't get out~!!
Grass! Trainer-san, help meee~!!

I dug too deep and got stuck.
Still, this rushed digging seems to have built up some power.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Her quiet nature! I see, I see. Suzuka-senpai
only spoke just a tiny little bit, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: If El becomes one with nature and stays as quiet as a forest, surely my concentration will...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh. Darkness, silence, chirping bugs...
Though ghosts and monsters are no problem for me, DESU.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fueeee, I wanna chat, *desu*.
Grass~, say something, pleeease~!

Grass Wonder smiles wryly. Her concentration wasn't
honed, but her sheer grit certainly was.
